target.title: feat(ios): add OpenClawMascot iconography system with size scale
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The iOS app uses a raw `Image("OpenClawIcon")` call scattered across multiple views (`CommandCenterTab`, `RootTabs`, `OnboardingWizardSteps`) with ad-hoc sizing and shadow parameters. There is no consistent mascot asset catalog entry, no predefined scale system, and no reusable badge/ghost variants.

## Why This Change Was Made

The branded styling guide specifies a 6-tier mascot size scale (hero 96pt → inline 20pt) with a minimum rendered size of 20pt. This PR implements the mascot iconography system as a standalone component set, decoupled from the broader design-system PR (#99161).

Supersedes #99188 which was stacked on the design-system branch and pulled in unrelated changes.

## User Impact

- **Visual**: Mascot renders from a proper 3-scale asset catalog entry (1x/2x/3x) instead of a single image, improving rendering quality across device densities.
- **Consistency**: All mascot usages now go through `OpenClawMascot` with standardized scale tiers.
- **No behavioral changes**: This PR modifies only mascot rendering; no config, settings, or runtime behavior is affected.

## Changes

### New files
- `apps/ios/Sources/Design/OpenClawMascot.swift` — `OpenClawMascotScale` enum (6 tiers), `OpenClawMascot` view, `OpenClawMascotBadge` (status overlay), `OpenClawMascotGhost` (watermark variant)
- `apps/ios/Sources/Assets.xcassets/OpenClawMascot.imageset/` — 1x (171px), 2x (341px), 3x (512px) PNGs

### Modified files
- `OpenClawProComponents.swift` — `OpenClawProMark` now delegates to `OpenClawMascot(size:)` (legacy wrapper kept)
- `CommandCenterTab.swift` — `OpenClawProMark(size: 28)` → `OpenClawMascot(scale: .nav)`
- `OnboardingWizardSteps.swift` — `OpenClawProMark(size: 64)` → `OpenClawMascot(scale: .emptyState)`
- `RootTabs.swift` — `OpenClawProMark(size: 30)` → `OpenClawMascot(scale: .section)`
- `RootTabsSourceGuardTests.swift` — Updated assertion to match new usage

### Asset provenance
Source: OpenClaw CDN mascot PNG (512×512), scaled via `sips` to 1x/2x/3x.

## Evidence

- iOS app target compiles successfully (only pre-existing WatchApp asset catalog error remains, same on `upstream/main`)
- SwiftFormat clean
- Self-contained mascot palette — no dependency on design-system tokens; uses private color constants matching the branded style guide values

— [Joel Nishanth](https://offlyn.ai) · [offlyn.AI](https://offlyn.ai)

Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
